articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
articles.snippet: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
articles.snippet: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

articles.title: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record
articles.snippet: Toto Finance wants 22 million ADA from Cardano’s treasury to buy tokenized copper, and the metal would have to trade well above its all-time high for holders to get their money back.

articles.title: Senate's top Democratic investigator looking into Tether payments to Bo Hines' firm
articles.snippet: Senator Richard Blumenthal, the ranking Democrat on the investigations subcommittee, added a probe of the ex-White House crypto adviser to his list of crypto interests.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.snippet: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.
